summary: Petition to recognize a foreign adoption.
applies: Title 18-C (Maine Uniform Probate Code), effective 2019-09-01 — see transition_18a.

considerations.title: Foreign adoptions
considerations.note: A valid foreign decree is the basis for recognition.

considerations.title: Petition for adoption and change of name; filing fee
considerations.note: Name change may be requested as part of the adoption/recognition.

transition_18a: 18-C Article 9 governs adoption proceedings under the current code; §9-108 addresses application of prior laws to pending matters.
